title: Profile approval expiry (default 24h, --ttl)
description: DEC-217 / ODOC-488 step 2a: approvals carry an expiry field, default 24h, explicit --ttl at approval; admission checks expiry inside the transaction. Changes the vault format, so lands before any freeze.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ward profile approve accepts --ttl and defaults to 24h
Admission after expiry is refused with a fixed code, makes no network attempt and writes no admission audit record
Expiry is checked inside the admission transaction
docs/security-tests.md or its test list names the expiry tests

implementationNotes: Built per DEC-217 Q5, recorded as ADR 0021. Choices for review: --ttl bounds 1m..30d and grammar <int><m|h|d> are this build detail; expiry is checked at the run pre-read and inside the admission transaction, not at completion; list/check report expired as a state and a reason. Stacked on the WCLI-12 branch; rebase after opum-ai/ward-cli#149 lands.

opum-doc verdict on #152 at dd62e227 (reviewer opum-doc, claude-opus-5-5): APPROVE once two docs fixes land at the moved head, no re-review. Fixes: T13 expiry row in docs/security-tests.md naming test/approval-expiry.test.ts; ADR 0021 and the restore runbook state that a vault written before approvals carried expiresAt fails to parse (allowed pre-release, WCLI-38): re-approve or restore from a fresh backup. Both done at b54a6e3. Accepted build detail: 30-day --ttl maximum.
